title: Roast chicken with crispy potatoes and gravy
notes: Edge-case example: three background timers overlap (chicken, potatoes, carrots), most timers are ranges, and some ingredients have no quantity. Butter and oil are split across steps.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Take the chicken out of the fridge.
steps.tip: Chicken that isn't fridge-cold cooks more evenly.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.text: Pat the chicken dry. Rub it all over with 30 g butter, ½ tsp dried thyme, salt and pepper. Put the lemon halves and 4 thyme sprigs inside.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.text: Put the chicken in the roasting tin, breast side up, and roast. Carry on with the potatoes while it cooks.
steps.cue: Juices run clear when you pierce the thigh, or 74°C in the thickest part.

steps.title: Parboil the potatoes
steps.text: Put 1.2 kg halved potatoes in a large pot of cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer.

steps.title: Rough up the potatoes
steps.text: Drain well and leave to steam dry for 2 minutes, then put the lid on and shake the pan to fluff the edges.
steps.tip: The fluffy edges are what turn crisp.

steps.title: Roast the potatoes
steps.text: Heat 60 ml olive oil in the second tray in the oven for 5 minutes. Tip in the potatoes, turn to coat and roast on the shelf below the chicken.
steps.cue: Deep golden and crisp. Turn once halfway.

steps.title: Roast the carrots
steps.text: Toss 500 g carrots with 15 ml olive oil and 1 tbsp honey. Add them to the potato tray.

steps.title: Rest the chicken
steps.text: Lift the chicken onto a board, cover loosely with foil and leave to rest. Keep the roasting tin and its juices for the gravy.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: Put the roasting tin over medium heat. Stir 20 g flour and 10 g butter into the juices, then whisk in 375 ml stock and simmer.
steps.cue: Thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.text: Season the gravy with salt and pepper. Carve the chicken and serve with the potatoes and carrots, scattered with parsley.
